queries.name: value-measurement-facts
queries.subject: Original native primary and diagnostic observations from reviewed batch evaluators.
queries.objective: Keep periods, native units, evaluator identity and missingness inspectable without inventing delivery events.
queries.acceptance: Null is unavailable, not zero. Interval measurements are not snapshots or cumulative accepted contributions.

queries.name: value-primary-measurements
queries.subject: Retained repository-scoped primary Operational Value observations.
queries.objective: Compare only primary native measures while preserving every assessment, including unavailable assessments.
queries.acceptance: Diagnostic metrics never replace or reorder the primary measure history.

queries.name: value-measurement-predecessor-core
queries.subject: Immediate prior assessments for each exact repository, workflow, campaign and native measure.
queries.objective: Retain the predecessor before selecting the latest assessment.
queries.acceptance: Ordering includes unavailable assessments and uses exact period, assessment and identity tie-breakers.

queries.name: value-measurement-predecessor-contract
queries.subject: Contract and quality fields from each immediate prior assessment.
queries.objective: Make every comparison requirement explicit before movement is classified.
queries.acceptance: Unit, direction, kind, cadence, duration, coverage, maturity and population remain native fields.

queries.name: value-measurement-order
queries.subject: Latest-first primary assessment order with immediate predecessor context.
queries.objective: Select the latest assessment only after preserving the preceding retained assessment.
queries.acceptance: A newer unavailable, partial, immature or null assessment remains rank one.

queries.name: value-current-measurement-quality
queries.subject: Quality gates for the latest primary assessment and its immediate predecessor.
queries.objective: Distinguish a valid baseline from unavailable, partial, immature or unsupported current evidence.
queries.acceptance: Complete mature non-null native evidence with explicit evaluator, unit, cadence and period is required.

queries.name: value-current-measurement-comparability
queries.subject: Explicit comparability checks between the latest and immediately preceding primary assessments.
queries.objective: Permit movement only for the same frozen native contract and valid adjacent period semantics.
queries.acceptance: Intervals have equal duration and abut exactly; snapshots compare advancing declared cutoffs.

queries.name: value-current-measurements
queries.subject: Current native Operational Value state and immediately preceding comparable period.
queries.objective: Expose Baseline, Improving, Worsening, Unchanged or Insufficient with exact native evidence.
queries.acceptance: Current selection precedes quality gates. Missing, partial, immature, unsupported or incomparable evidence remains Insufficient.

queries.name: value-native-workflow-topology
queries.subject: Canonical workflow topology used to validate native Value membership.
queries.objective: Derive campaign and standalone membership only from workflow inventory.
queries.acceptance: Measurement rows do not grant campaign membership or change workflow role.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-topology
queries.subject: Canonical campaign worker deployments for native Value aggregation.
queries.objective: Exclude orchestrators, standalone workflows and unclassified campaign identities.
queries.acceptance: Only declared workers contribute to campaign repository movement.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-result-context
queries.subject: Current native movement joined to canonical campaign worker topology.
queries.objective: Validate exact repository and campaign identity before campaign aggregation.
queries.acceptance: A measurement's campaign text cannot synthesize worker membership.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-results
queries.subject: Current native movement for exact canonical campaign worker deployments.
queries.objective: Provide one latest primary result per native measure before repository aggregation.
queries.acceptance: Repository and campaign identity must both match canonical topology.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-repository-measures
queries.subject: Current measure-state counts for each exact campaign repository.
queries.objective: Prepare categorical repository rollup without summing native values.
queries.acceptance: Baseline contributes to Insufficient movement; current valid evidence still counts as measured coverage.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-repository-status
queries.subject: One categorical native Value status per campaign repository.
queries.objective: Deduplicate repositories after latest primary measure selection.
queries.acceptance: Any insufficient measure makes the repository Insufficient; opposing movement is Mixed before Worsening, Improving or Unchanged.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-movement-counts
queries.subject: Repository-deduplicated native Value movement counts per campaign.
queries.objective: Expose categorical movement and measured repository coverage.
queries.acceptance: Each repository counts once and unlike native metrics are never averaged, summed or scored.

queries.name: value-native-campaign-population
queries.subject: Canonical repository population represented by each campaign's workers.
queries.objective: Provide a declared worker-repository denominator for measured coverage.
queries.acceptance: This is workflow topology, not target enrollment or proof every eligible repository was measured.

queries.name: value-campaign-measurement-summary
queries.subject: Native Operational Value movement diagnosis for every retained campaign.
queries.objective: Retain zero-measurement campaigns and expose repository-deduplicated movement counts and measured coverage.
queries.acceptance: Counts are categorical evidence, not a score, causal attribution or aggregation of unlike native values.
